publishedfiledetails.title: Advanced Vault System: Remastered
publishedfiledetails.description:
[h1]Advanced Vault System, but smoother, better and cooler.[/h1]
Version: 1.5

[h1]IF YOU GET STUCK IN OBJECTS WHENEVER YOU VAULT, MAKE SURE YOU ENABLE WMO[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=925018569
But from now on WMO will not be a dependency.

[h1]Space Marine Expansion[/h1] https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2794729687
[h1]Spartans Expansion[/h1] https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3391132245

Old mod was my first experience in animating something for Arma skeleton, and the code was not good at all.
I decided that i need to return and re-do the mod up to my current standarts. And, here it is! 

[h1]Mod can fit many play styles, starting from milsim, ending with Titanfall a-like OP. Its all up to you! Cause you can customize some parts of the mod.[/h1]

[h1]Whats new in this version?[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Whole code was re-writen from scratch. It can detect most of the geometries properly. Its not perfect, but its better then it was previously. 
[*]No more invisible arrows that break helicopters, antistasi and other things.
[*]No more going underwater if you are trying to vault above water surfaces.
[*]No weird camera glitches, all actions now smooth and will not cause headache.
 [*] No more FPS loses. Codes only runs when it needs to.
 [*] NO MORE TELEPORTATIONS TO THE EDGE OF THE MAP! That annoying bug was finally fixed.
 [*] Most of the animations were re-done. Weapon bones were fixed and do not flex whenever you vault over something. Interpolation (Smoothness) between animations were improved. Animations are as smooth as i can get. 
[*] Didnt wanted to re-animate everything, but still there is a lot of new stuff.
[*] New advanced parkour animations.
[*] If you dont like something - you can easily - disable it, or if you like - enable. Most of parts of AVS can be adjusted in Configure - Game - Configure Addons
[/list]

[h1]Controls[/h1]
[h1]You can change keybinds through Configure - Controls - Configure Addons[/h1]
[list]
 [*] Press V to vault/climb/jump (By default)
[*]Look down and press same keybind as vaulting and you will jump down.
[*] Press SHIFT+X to slide/roll. (By default)
[/list]

[h1]PLEASE JOIN MY DISCORD, IT IS EASIER TO ANSWER YOUR QUESTIONS/BUG REPORTS FOR ME THERE - https://discord.gg/UJfDvdyr7w[/h1]
Have fun!

Main Credits:
[u]Macser - For awesome ArmaRig for blender!
Bohemia Interactive - For awesome game and platform!
My patreons - for supporting my work.
[/u]

publishedfiledetails.title: Alternative Running
publishedfiledetails.description:
[h1]Alternative Running - is a mod that will allow you to sprint in alternative way by pressing Double Shift. (Similar to Call of Duty Modern Warfare 2019)

If you do not know how to use it, please watch the video.
 [/h1]

Version: 4.0 
Animation and code was maded from scratch by me.

YOU CAN DISABLE THE ANIMATION BY PRESSING THE SAME KEY YOU BOUND YOUR ALTERNATIVE RUNNING, OR BY PRESSING YOUR MOVEMENT/PRONE/CROUCH KEYS.

publishedfiledetails.title: Better Inventory
publishedfiledetails.description:
Are you also annoyed to switch between Uniform, Vest and Backpack?
Here is the solution to this madness.

[h1][u]Features:[/u][/h1]
- Changed Inventory Layout
- Contents of Uniform, Vest and Backpack are visible at the same time.
- [b]Clientside Mod[/b]. The Mod only needs to be whitelisted on the Server and have CBA installed.
- [b]Stack Moving[/b]. Move many Items/Magazines at the same Time.
- [b]Task Force Radio Buttons[/b] to open the settings of equipped Radios.

[h1][u]Stack Moving:[/u][/h1]
- [b]Hold Shift[/b] while moving Items to move 5 Items at the same time.
- [b]Hold Ctrl[/b] to move as many items as possible.
- The Key Bindings can be changed under [b]"Options-->Controls-->Better Inventory"[/b].
- When you stack move a Magazine that has not Full Ammo, it will only move other Magazines that have not Full Ammo, the same goes for Full Magazines.

[b][u]Limitations:[/u][/b]
- Only Items and Magazines can be Stack Moved.
- Not Weapons or Containers like Uniforms.
- Not from Containers(Boxes/Vehicles) to Ground.

- The Limitations are because of the hardcoded nature of the Arma 3 Inventory and limited scripting possibilities for that.

[h1][u]Compatibility:[/u][/h1]
The Mod has Build-in Compatibility with the following Mods.
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=463939057]Ace[/url]
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=751965892]ACRE2[/url]
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1334412770]Dual Arms - Two Primary Weapons[/url]
- [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1487484880]ExileMod[/url]
- Should be compatible with every other mod/mission that doesn't drastically changes the Inventory.

[h1][u]Known Bugs/Problems:[/u][/h1]
- When you stack move magazines from a container with many (1000 or so) Magazines, the game lags for a second. This is because you can not move Magazines in Arma 3 with a script, so the mod needs to delete and readd all Magazines. I try to fix/ease this problem in the next update.
- Singleplayer Equipment Menu for AI etc. at the start of the Game is not working.

[h1][u]Bug Reporting:[/u][/h1]
- Please provide your video resolution and interface size settings as part of your bug report if your report is ui related.
- Try to reproduce the bug with all other mods except CBA disabled.
- You can still report bugs only happening in combination with other mods but please try to provide as much information as possible. If possible share your modlist with me or even better the exact mod if you can identify it yourself.

[h1][u]Repacking/Reupload of the Mod:[/u][/h1]
- You are allowed to repack this mod as long as its not bundled into a public mod on the steam workshop or somewhere else online.
- Private (aka friends only) mods on the workshop or somewhere else are allowed.

[h1][u]Donations:[/u][/h1]
Want to thank me and support my work with a Donation?

[url=https://ko-fi.com/xaneas] [img]https://i.imgur.com/at6IvJM.png[/img] [/url]

publishedfiledetails.title: CBA_A3
publishedfiledetails.description:
[h1][b]CBA: Community Based Addons for Arma 3[/b][/h1]

What does the name Community Base Addons mean? It is a system that:
[list]
[*]Offers a range of features for addon-makers and mission designers.
[*]Aims to have community wide acceptance and to be used as much as possible by community addons to maintain compatibility.
[*]The community is very much encouraged to request or submit functionality.
[*]The most obvious example would be to submit functions to be included in the CBA function library.
[/list]
[u][b]Documentation[/b][/u]
Full documentation is available at [url=https://cbateam.github.io/CBA_A3/docs/files/overview-txt.html]GitHub[/url] 

[u][b]Licensed Under GPLv2[/b][/u]
Any addon which calls CBA-defined functions need not be licensed under the GPLv2
or released under a free software license. Only if you are directly including CBA code
in your addon's binarized PBO or redistributing a modified version of CBA itself would
your work be considered derivative and therefore be legally required to be released under
the terms of the GPL. (And there's no reason to ever do either of these.)

publishedfiledetails.title: CH View Distance
Death and Hit reactions
publishedfiledetails.description:
Had this idea for a while. Wanted to make game just a little bit cinematic.

[h1]Mod must be installed on both client and server[/h1]

This mod is also serving another purpose: to more or less syncronize ragdoll in MP environment just a little bit when death animations enabled. Because after dying units are playing an animation and only afterwards ragdoll, it allow arma to not syncronize full path of a ragdoll but only the end of it making an interpolation much smoother. It is not perfect, but still.

[h1]Mod works with both ACE, PIR, Armour Plate system. Mod do not modify any damage, only adds animations and work with vanilla params. So it will be compatible with every other mod.[/h1]

Aditional PIR compat patch: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3002800433

[h1]So what does this mod contain in its current state?[/h1]
[list]
 [*]  More then 70 death animations that varies on different conditions (Headshot, neckshots, grenade, crouch, high caliber,dismemberment,prone)
 [*] 20 hit animations 
[*] Options to disable certain mechanics
[/list]

[h1]What will be added in a nearest future?[/h1]
[list]
 [*]  Pistol hit animations
 [*] QOL updates
[/list]

[h1]You can disable death and hit reactions on units via this command:[/h1]
this setVariable ["WBK_DAH_DisableAnim_Death",1]; - for death animations
this setVariable ["WBK_DAH_DisableAnim_Hit",1]; - for hit reactions


[h1]Thats all, hope you'll like it. If you have questions, suggestions, bug reports or want to check out what i am working on now - please join my discord - https://discord.gg/UJfDvdyr7w[/h1]

Bohemia Interactive - For awesome game and platform!
Mixamo and Valve - animation references
My patreons - for support. Huge thanks to you guys! You made this mod possible.
[/u]

publishedfiledetails.title: Drongos Grenade Tweaks
publishedfiledetails.description:
AI are much more likely to use hand-grenades, grenade launchers, RPG-7s, RPG-32 and MRAWs against infantry. Grenade damage radius is increased by about 50%.

It is recommended you test with no other mods loaded first.

[url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mNEsvi7MlxvbmaHYVXEsr7TzyQokddHh/view?usp=sharing]Source for easy editing[/url]

OVERVIEW
This mod tweaks vanilla configs for the following effects:

Grenades and RPG-7s have had their indirect damage radius increased by about 50%
AI are much more likely to use hand grenades
AI are much more likely to use grenade launchers
AI are much more likely to use RPG-7s against infantry, vehicles and aircraft
AI are much more likely to use MRAW and RPG-32 HE rounds against infantry, vehicles and aircraft

The design philosphy is for AI to "use it or lose it". Too often AI with explosive weapons are just ammo crates with a rifle. This mod leans into making AI grenade and launcher use very common rather than restrained.


NOTES
This mod only addresses vanilla assets and assets that inherit the same values.
Sometimes AI will use a grenade when they should have used a rifle instead.
If LAMBS Danger is present, a slightly different config will load.
LAMBS RPG will overwrite some parts of this mod.
The mod consists of a single fairly straightforward and config.cpp with some documentation. Making your own version to suit your own preferences is encouraged.

publishedfiledetails.title: Hide Among The Grass - HATG
publishedfiledetails.description:
[url=https://github.com/SilenceIsFatto/HATG][img]https://i.imgur.com/sRVM4Ws.png[/img][/url]
Hide Among The Grass (HATG) is a performance-focused solution to all things stealth.

This mod was originally designed as an alternative to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2946868556]ACSTG[/url] but we very quickly realised we could do more.

You will only be hidden when prone or crouched (and standing, if in a building). A variety of factors apply, such as enemies being close or what surface you are on. These can all be configured!

Other AI mods should be compatible. This mod does not touch AI behaviour, it functions around the way AI "sees".

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*][i]The ability to hide among the grass.[/i]

[*][i]The ability to revamp your stealth gameplay. Ever wanted a ghillie suit to actually stop the AI from seeing you? Now it does.[/i]

[*][i]A logical and simplistic approach to concealment. Shooting from afar with a suppressor? You'll remain hidden for longer.[/i]

[*][i]A minimalistic UI to help you know when you are hidden or not. This is ON by default. If you prefer a more "realistic" setting, you can turn it off in the settings.[/i]

[*][i]A "simple mode" setting so you don't have to worry about configuring settings one by one.[/i]

[*][i]Environmental consideration. During the night or if it is raining/foggy, detection distance will be lowered.[/i]

[*][i]Flexible CBA settings, allowing you to change just about anything in the mod.[/i]

[*][i]Singleplayer support. Your AI squad will have the same stealth possibilities as you do! (Only in SP)[/i]

[*][i]Localization. Note: Only English and Russian have been translated by humans. Feel free to check out our github at the bottom of the page and fix any translation errors![/i]
[/list]

[h1]Questions[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]"Why can't I do X or Y when I'm hidden?"[/b]

This is due to engine limitations. You can bind a key to toggle HATG functionality on/off when you need.

[*][b]"What's the difference between this mod and ACSTG?"[/b]

The main difference between HATG and ACSTG is: 
HATG is [i]faster[/i] and [i]better for performance[/i].

This is by no means a jab at ACSTG - this idea came from ACSTG and I think parts of their solution are quite smart but lack optimization.

Read the [url=https://github.com/SilenceIsFatto/HATG/blob/main/README.md]github[/url] for more information about ACSTG vs HATG performance if you wish.

[*][b]"Is this mod compatible with X?"[/b]

Generally, yes. This mod was actually designed and heavily tested on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3020755032]Antistasi Ultimate[/url] with the help of the [url=https://discord.gg/antistasiultimate]Antistasi Ultimate Community[/url].

It is not advised to run this mod with ACSTG. HATG and ACSTG both achieve similar things and may conflict.

[*][b]"Is this mod clientside?"[/b]

No. HATG uses a custom object which needs to be available on the server or else it will not block AI vision.

This may be possible in the future in which a different method will be used if the server does not have HATG.

[*][b]"How does this mod work?"[/b]

When you meet the requirements to be "hidden", a box is created and attached to you.

This box prevents the AI from seeing you.
[/list]

[h1]Notes[/h1]

Common Issues:
- "I can't see the UI, even though it is on"
> You may have to change the UI Y position in the addon options.

- "The mod is preventing me from interacting with things, etc"
> Bind the "Toggle HATG" keybind and use it to disable the mod when you need to.

Special thanks to:
- stutpip123 for giving the "mirror" idea and allowing us to extensively test this on his servers.
- The [url=https://discord.gg/antistasiultimate]Antistasi Ultimate Community[/url] for putting up with our testing and debugging.
- ACSTG for the inspiration to start this project.

Our aim is to allow this mod to be further developed by the community if they wish, GitHub link below.
[url=https://github.com/SilenceIsFatto/HATG][img]https://i.imgur.com/z9xYpjf.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://github.com/sponsors/SilenceIsFatto][img]https://i.imgur.com/hD8yyCQ.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/silence112][img]https://i.imgur.com/RmlMO5p.png[/img][/url]

All we ask is that you remain fair, maintain a list of every contributor, refrain from altering the license and include a link back to this page if you decide to redistribute.

publishedfiledetails.title: JSRS SOUNDMOD 2025
publishedfiledetails.description:
[b][h1]Welcome to a next era of immersive sound for Arma 3![/h1][/b]
JSRS SOUNDMOD 2025 takes the audio experience to the new level, setting new standards for authenticity and creating a seamless, all-encompassing soundscape.

🌟 [b]What is it?[/b]
[b]JSRS SOUNDMOD 2025[/b] is the evolution of the beloved soundmod, delivering a revamped and modernized sound environment for Arma 3. The focus is on creating a unified and immersive soundscape for all assets.

[list]
[*][b]Completely reworked weapon sound architecture[/b]
Weapons now operate on a clean [i]Shot + Tail[/i] system with clearly separated positioning and spatialization.
This drastically reduces clutter while improving clarity, punch and distance perception.

[*][b]Advanced Tail & Distance System[/b]
A fully rebuilt tail system with refined fade behavior, spatial depth and environmental response.
No artificial layering, no stereo gimmicks — just controlled, believable distance acoustics.

[*][b]EVR – Environmental Vehicle Reverberation[/b]
A new vehicle audio layer simulating reflected pressure and environmental response.
Adds mass, scale and presence to helicopters and jets — without relying on obstruction tricks.

[*][b]Expanded Movement & Interaction Audio[/b]
New dedicated sounds for tactical movement, ADS, leaning, inventory, map interaction and NVG usage.
Slow movement is now genuinely quiet — sprinting and panic movement are not.

[*][b]Biome & Atmospheric Soundscape[/b]
Distinct audio layers for Nordic, Boreal, Winter, Savanna, Temperate Europe, Jungle and Tropic environments.
Includes wildlife, wind, weather and terrain-dependent ambience.

[*][b]Enhanced Soundscape Integration[/b]
Gunfire dynamically echoes off of distant hills and mountain areas, adding natural reflections and depth based on terrain.

[*][b]Modernized Audio Pipeline[/b]
Internally rebuilt configs, naming structure and build pipeline (HEMTT-based) for long-term stability, scalability and maintainability.
[/list]

[b]This is not just louder sound.[/b]
[b]It is a cleaner, more controlled and more physically grounded audio system for Arma 3.[/b]

[b]Dev Branch–Only Features (Not available on Stable)[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Interior Explosion Sounds[/b]
Explosions that occur inside buildings use a dedicated interior acoustic model, including enclosed pressure response and reduced exterior bleed.
This feature relies on engine-side functionality that is currently only available on the Dev / Profiling branch.

[*][b]Dynamic Ducking System[/b]
A real-time ducking effect based on the newer xAudio backend, allowing weapons and explosions to naturally push back environmental sounds.
This improves clarity, punch and overall mix control, but is not supported by the Stable branch audio driver.
[/list]

These features are therefore [b]exclusive to the Dev Build[/b].
If Bohemia Interactive reverts the newer xAudio backend, the ducking system will be affected accordingly.

📥 [b]How to Install and Use:[/b]
Easy as always:[list]
[*]Subscribe to JSRS Soundmod 2025 (Beta RC3)
[*]Activate the mod in the launcher and enjoy[/list]


🚧 [b]Important Notes:[/b]
Frequent updates are based on your feedback! Join the discussion to shape the mod's future. Support on Patreon for [b]exclusive access to development builds and direct involvement in new features.[/b]

[b]All-in-One Compatibility Integration[/b]
The previously separate AiO Compatibility Pack is now fully integrated into this release.
All supported compatibility modules are included by default.

[list]
[*]No additional downloads required
[*]Compatibility is handled internally by JSRS
[/list]

If you do [b]not[/b] want to use certain compatibility modules, you can safely remove them manually:

[i]jsrs2025\addons\compat_xyz[/i]

Simply delete the corresponding compat addon pbo and bisign files for the mod you don’t want to covered by JSRS.
This allows full control over which integrations are active without affecting the core mod.


🔗 [b]Links to Discord and Patreon:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KsoQMCF.png[/img]

Your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions are greatly appreciated! Thank you for your support, which makes JSRS Soundmod possible.

[b][url=https://www.patreon.com/c/lordjarhead/membership]JSRS Soundmod Patreon Support[/url][/b]

Become an [b]Operator[/b] and join the frontlines of development! As an Operator, you'll gain exclusive access to:[list]

publishedfiledetails.title: Project SFX: Remastered
publishedfiledetails.description:
Footsteps:
(Originally wanted to make them part of Project SFX, but decided to make them separate, cause not everyone will like them)
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2806487814

Project SFX: Remastered is an extension of audio elements in Arma 3.

► So, what does the mod include?

◆ Extra weapon bass and low ammo sound effects (Like in PayDay or CS:GO)
◆ Death sounds for different character states (combat, stealth, headshot, underwater, inside the house, inside the equipment).
◆ Various sounds for players (jumping/landing sounds for different types of surfaces, throwing grenades, body hits sounds, inventory sounds, aiming sounds, concussion effect from explosions, body falling sounds).
◆ Replacement of standard Arma sounds, such as: Background shooting, alarm, thunder sounds, etc.
◆ New environmental sounds that you can play through Zeus or use in swine missions.


► Compatibility
Full multi-user compatibility (This is not a server or client mod, the client and server must both enable this mod).
Compatible with mods such as Real Engine, Enhanced Soundscape, Unit Voice Over, JSRS, FEMALE, ENFORCER, Max Women, Zombie and Daemons and Ravaged.
Bikey for dedicated servers.


► What's new in the remastered version?
As I said, I have removed the sounds that caused me problems with the last mod.
However, I couldn't record these sounds myself, so they were all taken from various resources (YouTube, Day of Infamy). All sounds belong to their authors. I do not claim the rights of these recordings in any way! All rights belong to their original authors.
I added the new environmental sounds I mentioned earlier, new aiming sounds, and removed the annoying injury system I had before. It was stupid of me to add any edits to the game mechanics that are not related to sounds. I apologize for that.

► What will be added?
It's up to you guys, if you have any suggestions, please leave comments in the discussions.

New World Interactive

publishedfiledetails.title: Pylon Manager
Splendid Smoke
publishedfiledetails.description:
What does it do?
The mod reworks the smoke effects of various weapons and events. In the initial version this includes much bigger smoke clouds created by all types of smoke grenades.

The main aspect is the improvement of the visual experience while not decreasing the performance compared to vanilla. In general this means that the amount of spawned particles remains unchanged.

Features
The following list presents all added/changed features:

* reworked effects of smoke grenades
  ** double the size
  ** more volume due to increased spreading
  ** blocks the sight of AI
  ** same particle amount than in vanilla (performant, particle limit is not reached faster)
* compatible with common mods like ACE
* small and compact, no overhead
* perfomant

Troubleshooting
* The smoke effect does not look like in the video?
  ** If you use any mods, try again without (vanilla). If the problem still persists, locate the problematic mod. Ensure that SplendidSmoke is loaded after this mod, this should fix the issue. In either case contact us here, at the Bistudio Forum or at GitHub so we can fix the issue also for others.
* The smoke effects do not apply to a modded smoke grenade?
  ** The modded grenade probably does not inherit from the vanilla grenades. Contact us here, at the Bistudio Forum or at GitHub so we can add support for this mod.

Source
The source of this mod is available at GitHub, it is published under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

Links
Bistudio Forum: https://forums.bistudio.com/topic/194479-splendid-smoke/
GitHub: https://github.com/ZabuzaW/SplendidSmoke

publishedfiledetails.title: SSD Death Screams 2.1
publishedfiledetails.description:
For a long time I thought Arma lacked some kind of feedback whenever a unit was injured or killed, making combat feel somewhat stale and oddly quiet. After playing games such as Red Orchestra 2 and Battlefield, I noticed how hit feedback (such as screams, grunts, cries, etc) can make for a much more visceral experience. Therefore, I decided to use some of these sounds to give Arma a similar level of auditory depth.

I've been using this mod privately with my group for a while, but I decided to release it as I think it reached a passable level of quality. So any feedback, positive or negative, will be greatly appreciated!


[h1]Features:[/h1]


This mod adds various injury sound effects to Arma 3 such as screams, blood gurgles, etc, from games such as Battlefield 3/4/1/5, Red Orchestra 2 and Chivalry: Medieval Warfare. The mod will play the corresponding sound depending on the injury that a soldier receives. For example, a soldier getting hit will play a lower pitched scream or grunt while emitting a higher pitched shriek when killed. Afterwards, the soldier may have "death rattle" noises such as blood gurgling if he was shot in the neck or intense panicked screaming if hit in the stomach. There are also variants which play indoors with reverb, or outdoors with a light echo.

The mod is also MP compatible and signed, so all players will hear the exact same sound as all work is handled serverside and then broadcast to the clients.

There are over 400 individual sounds included in the mod, with many more planned to be added in subsequent updates. However, the mod is still highly work in progress so it might not work 100% perfectly and the death rattles have no indoor variations quite yet.


[h1]Configuring:[/h1]


This mod now supports the CBA addon options menu with many customizable settings! These are unique to each client so every player can tailor the mod to his or her tastes.

Access these new options by going to Options -> Addon Options -> SSD Death Screams. Be sure to press OK to save your new settings!

If you wish to disable hit reactions from specific units you can use (this setVariable ["SSD_disabledSounds", true]) in their init field.


[h1]Important:[/h1]


If being used on a server, be it hosted or dedicated, the server [b]must[/b] have the mod installed and enabled in addition to all clients, otherwise the sounds may not play at all.


[h1]Known Issues:[/h1]

[list]
[*]There is currently some unpredictable behavior while using ACE due to it messing with the "HitPart" event handler and detecting whether a unit has died or not. I am currently investigating some workarounds.

[*]Screams from being burnt by a wreck or other fire sources are currently disabled due to some issues I've run into, but I will try to have them working eventually.[/list]


[h1]Credits:[/h1]


This mod is inspired by Froggyluv's "FrogScreams" addon which can be found at: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=686515642&searchtext=Frog+Screams

publishedfiledetails.title: Vehicle Inventory System
publishedfiledetails.description:
[b]This addon adds the capability to manage the inventory of vehicles using profiled loadouts, similar to the BI or ACE Arsenal Loadouts when the vehicle is near a BI or ACE arsenal[/b]

This system is intended to allow anyone to develop and save a custom vehicle loadout without having to write scripts and record item classnames. Simply configure a vehicle inventory as you like, save the loadout as a profile and load it into any vehicle near an ACE or BI virtual arsenal.

[b] If you leave a negative rating, please leave me a comment so I know what you'd like fixed[/b]

This is designed to work in SP, MP and Dedicated with human and AI vehicles.

This is a Beta release. 

[b]***For best results, use with the AmmoCan mod, to save vehicle profiles with additional ammo![/b] https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2162698437

[b]***For best results, use with the Helocast mod, to expedite the loading of equipment into CRRCs![/b] https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1947483966

[b]Supported Vehicles:[/b][LIST]
[*]All mobile Vehicles are Supported by Default (Static Turrets are not supported at this time)
[/LIST]


[b]Features:[/b][LIST]
[*]Support for SP, MP and Dedicated
[*]Ability to clear existing inventory from a vehicle
[*]Ability to save and load inventory profiles for later use, or for quickly preparing for the mission at hand
[*]Tested & compatible with ALiVE and Zeus spawned vehicles
[*]Should be compatible with Liberation, Antistasi, etc. (Would love testing feedback)
[/LIST]

[b]Setup:[/b]
The vehicle must be near a BI or ACE arsenal and not moving - at that point the vehicle will have a scroll action to allow saving and loading.
[LIST]
[*]Non-armored vehicles must be within 30 meters
[*]Armored vehicles must be within 50 meters
[*]Aircraft must be within 200 meters
[*]Ships must be within 300 meters
[/LIST]

Vehicles are automatically ready to have profiles saved and loaded.
Simply fill a vehicle inventory to the desired specifications, and save the loadout. It can be loaded again into a vehicle for later use.
Loadouts are not vehicle specific, however it is recommended to make separate loadouts for vehicles with different carrying capacities, as to avoid truncating your inventory.

[b]Vehicle Loadout Procedure:[/b]
From anywhere you can access the inventory of a compatible vehicle, which has been parked nearby an BI or Ace Arsenal > From your inventory, deposit desired items into the vehicle > While near an BI or Ace arsenal, save the loadout via scroll interaction > Load the profile as needed.

[b]Tips:[/b]
Like the BI and Ace Arsenals, this mod does not 'add' items to the vehicle inventory, rather it sets the inventory to a given profile. When loading vehicles, be sure to load a profile as needed before adding any additional items.
The saves are associated with your ARMA 3 profile - if you change profiles, you won't see your saves.

[b]Limitations:[/b][LIST]
[*]The system does not track which addons you are using. If you make a save for items that aren't available they will be skipped (I think...feedback welcome)
[*]Overwriting save profiles is not yet implemented
[*]Vehicle Loadouts are not Vehicle Unique, so inventories that are too large for the vehicle you're trying to load won't work.
[*]Does not preserve ACE Cargo spaces. Any item in ACE Cargo will still need to be managed by hand.
[/LIST]

[b]Planned Updates:[/b][LIST]
[*]ACE Cargo compatibility
[*]Ability to overwrite existing save profiles
[*]Additional inventory realism features
[*]Static turret support
[/LIST]

[b]Usage Restrictions:[/b]
The GNU General Public License v3.0: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.en.html

I know folks are going to dePBO this, so the GPL license just basically asks that you mention me on any work based on this. I will be making my Github for this public once the addon is a bit more mature.

Anyone may add the raw PBOs for this mod into their own addons, etc.

[b]BIS Forum:[/b]
https://forums.bohemia.net/forums/topic/229969-vehicle-inventory-system/

[b]Acknowledgments and Thanks:[/b]
Roqarr

publishedfiledetails.title: WBK Simple Blood
publishedfiledetails.description:
[h1]Best to be used with:[/h1]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3596299237


Simple script that i was using is some of my mods. People were asking to make it as a standalone thing, so here it is.
Must be installed on both client and server.

Working with blood in Arma is hard, due to how engine handles particles and materials. So dont expect anything crazy here. If you want more advanced version for singleplayer experience i would suggest using any version of BloodLust.
This mod was developed with focus on multiplayer and low performance effect.
It works only on humans, so any custom skeletons will be untouched and therfore fully compatible with it.

You can now disable blood spawning on a specific unit via this command 
this setVariable ["WBK_BloodMod_Disable",true,true];

[h1]So what this mod does?[/h1]
[list]
 [*]  Spawns ANIMATED vanilla blood pools when unit dies. Size and type is defined whenever unit was shoot in a head or other side of the body.
 [*]  Spawns a blood splatter on walls if unit is standing close to them.
 [*]  Spawns blood particles on headshots (Can be disabled).
[/list]

[h1]Known issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Blood can look weird if it spawns inside of another blood pool. Thats an vanilla blood pool problem and i cant do anything about it.
[/list]


[h1]Thats all, hope you'll like it. If you want to use any of the animations from this mod in your project, or If you have questions, suggestions, bug reports or want to check out what i am working on now - please join my discord - https://discord.gg/UJfDvdyr7w[/h1]


Main Credits:
[u]My Discord community - Inspiration
My boys - For testing and playing
[/u]
